title: openetl-connector.yaml
description: A connector package, as its author writes it. `openetl connector package` builds it and writes its descriptor.

name.description: The package's name: owner/name, or name for the official owner, openetl. Each part is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63 characters.

title.description: A display name, such as PostgreSQL. None: the name.

license.description: An SPDX expression, such as Apache-2.0.

repository.description: The package's source repository. Its name stays with it.

docs.description: The package's documentation, which the console's connector catalog links to.

logo.description: An SVG or PNG image of at most 256 KiB, which the UI shows: a file beside this one, such as ./logo.svg, which is packaged with each version, or an https URL, which openetl connector publish copies into the registry.

author.description: Who makes the package, which the catalog shows.

tags.description: Words the catalog shows with the package, such as database.

platforms.description: The os/arch pairs to build. Default: linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64 and darwin/arm64.

roles.description: What the package provides, a source, a destination or both, and how each is built or run.

role.description: How one role is built, or run from an image or a manifest.

build.description: How to build the role's executable for each platform.

go.description: A Go main package, relative to this file, cross-compiled with `CGO_ENABLED=0`.

command.description: Run once with sh in this file's directory, with `OPENETL_VERSION` and `OPENETL_PLATFORMS` set.

output.description: Where `command` leaves each platform's executable, relative to this file, with `{os}` and `{arch}` in it.

image.description: An OCI image repository, without a tag: its tag is the release's version.

command.description: The image's argv, where it isn't its entrypoint.

manifest.description: A DeclarativeSource document, relative to this file. Sources only, and nothing else.

requires.description: What the role needs from the platform.

platform.description: The oldest openetl release the role runs on.

resources.description: A container launcher's requests and limits, and the job size the role wants.

cpu.description: CPU, as a Kubernetes quantity, such as 500m or 2.

memory.description: Memory, as a Kubernetes quantity, such as 512Mi.

hint.description: The job size a pipeline of this role starts at when it's sized automatically.

state.description: The version of the checkpoint state the role writes, and the oldest it can resume from.

version.description: The version of the state the role writes.

reads.description: The oldest version of the state the role can resume from.
